annotations.title: Withdraw a submission from App Review

description: Withdraw the app's submission that is waiting for or in App Review, so the version is editable again (swap the build, fix metadata) and can be resubmitted. Outward-facing: requires confirm:true. Pro feature.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually withdraw the submission.

platform.description: Needed only when more than one platform has a submission open
